Pattern.Intent: Implementation of an existing contract: root keeps `@purpose` + `@implements`; inherited members use `@see`; method body starts with executable code; non-trivial blocks wrapped in compact-form `#region START_...` / `#endregion END_...` anchors.
Pattern.Why: All mandatory protocols together: `// @file:` header, `@implements` on root, `@see` on member, executable-first body, compact single-payload anchor (invariant inlined on `#region` line), Trace-Prefixed log + error, cause-chain.
